record.field: Sent to people who sign up on the website, with the code and link that activate their account

div.style: margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; color: #1f2933;
div.p: Thanks for signing up at YourCompany. Enter this code on the activation page:
Or activate your account with one click:

a.style: background-color: #5b3fc4; color: #ffffff; padding: 10px 18px; border-radius: 6px; text-decoration: none; display: inline-block;

div.p: The code and the link expire in 15 minutes. If they expire, log in again and we will send new ones.
If you did not create this account, you can ignore this email.
